about: The life of a plugin as the user sees it (rich-plugins 4.14, O-124), written by hand and never captured. The plugin is parity/plugins/life (TS) and its Rust twin in crates/tui/tests/all/plugin_machines.rs. An observation is line/palette/row/dialog: the plugin's line in home.footer (A, B or -), whether the palette finds its commands (yes or no), its row in the plugin manager (on, off or failed), and whether its prompt shows (open or -). While the prompt shows, the readers open neither the palette nor the manager, which would replace it, so the first three are ?. Actions: toggle is enter on its row in the plugin manager; flip, throw, arm and dialog run its palette commands Life flip, Life throw, Life arm (the next setup throws) and Life dialog (opens its prompt); escape closes a dialog; reload puts a new build of the plugin in place. TS is the specification: an enable whose setup throws shows the error in a toast and leaves the row as it was, and a plugin's dialog stays open when it reloads. A row in xfail is a known difference, [client, deviation file or finding:<name>, 'state action observation'].
